description:
Come build what the market has been missing.    

 Octaura is a technology company transforming how some of the world’s largest, least digitized markets operate. In loans and CLOs, trillions of dollars still move through phones, emails, and PDFs because the right infrastructure hasn’t existed — until now.   

 We’re applying AI, real-time data, and modern software design to asset classes long overlooked by fintech. Our platforms turn fragmented information into intelligence, manual workflows into automation, and legacy conventions into scalable market infrastructure.   

 You’ll join a high-impact, collaborative team building the systems these markets need to become more transparent, efficient, and connected.   

  

 The role in a nutshell  

 Octaura is building out our tech team and we’re looking for Software Engineers interested in building high performance, next generation technology that will revolutionize the loans industry. This is an environment for those seeking to drive innovation and get charged up working with top engineering talent. We are looking for results-oriented developers who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, and enjoy solving challenging and complex customer problems.  

  

 This is an exciting time for Octaura as we are rapidly growing and are looking for energetic, collaborative and driven thinkers to join us! Please note this role is based out of our NYC office (at 5 Penn Plaza, 6 th Floor, New York, NY 10001) and our current structure is 4 days in the office (Monday-Thursday), 1 day from home (Friday). 

  

 Core responsibilities 

 
 
 Work with a team of smart and passionate engineers to build and maintain our proprietary electronic trading platform 

 Use modern tools and methods to expand the capabilities of our cloud-based application 

 Help to transition development of our platform to our in-house team 

 Collaborate with product teams to develop solutions for current and future customers 

 
 Desired experience 

 
 8+ years of experience software engineering and data-related technologies 

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field 

 Experience in Java (strongly preferred) or other Object-Oriented languages

 Experience in React, TypeScript desirable

 Experience in CSS, State Management (Redux / Context API), WebSockets desirable 

 Experience with Multithreading Design Patterns

 Experience with relational databases and SQL 

 Experience building cloud-based applications  

 Effective communication, organizational, and analytical skills 

 
 The base pay range for this position in New York is $180,000 - $200,000 annually. Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Equity and year-end bonus may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via Octaura's internal or external careers site.


 Octaura Work Perks 

 At Octaura, our people are our most valuable asset, and we are pleased to offer the following benefits to all full-time employees: 

 
 Competitive compensation and equity 

 Flexible Paid Time Off 

 Competitive Parental Leave  

 Daily breakfast, coffee and snacks in the office 

 90% company-paid healthcare 

 Onsite gym & discounted membership 

 
 We’re committed to equal opportunity employment  

 Octaura is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.
